description: Apache httpd 2.4.49 path-traversal exploitation. Centerpiece of the S17 composable-SUT story: the target host runs the real httpd:2.4.49 official image, the SUT composer drops the vulnerable httpd.conf the original Apache Security advisory describes, and the attacker exploits the disclosed path-traversal pattern over HTTP. Every step has audit-friendly evidence — the request URLs, the response body containing /etc/passwd contents, and the configuration that enabled the vulnerability.

techniques.name: Active Scanning: Vulnerability Scanning
techniques.description: Probe the target's Server header to confirm the vulnerable Apache version.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Send the canonical CVE-2021-41773 path-traversal request and verify /etc/passwd contents in the response.

techniques.name: File and Directory Discovery
techniques.description: Use the same traversal pattern to enumerate sensitive files (e.g., /etc/shadow if readable, /etc/hostname).

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.description: Persist the exfiltrated /etc/passwd on the attacker side as the collection artifact.
